remarks: Discover comfortable and stylish living in this beautifully updated one bedroom, one bathroom condo located in the highly desirable Glenbrook section of Stamford. This home features a modern kitchen with upscale stone countertops and stainless steel appliances, and a fantastic oversized island perfect for culinary enthusiasts. Enjoy a large, bright living room complete with a cozy fireplace and a TV wall mount, making it easy to set up your entertainment center. Step through the sliding doors to your private balcony, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Convenience is key with an in-unit front loading washer and dryer, an updated bathroom, and your own private, secure storage space. Parking is a breeze with a garage spot plus an additional assigned parking space! Common hallways have just been repainted and floors/stairs have new carpeting. Everything inside the unit and out is crisp, clean and bright. And to sweeten it all even more?.... brand new slider and windows are being installed! Experience the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience in this exceptional condo. Schedule a viewing today and make this Glenbrook gem your new home!
